create_saved_tensors_hooks: create a context manager with pack and unpack hooks for saving and retrieving tensors during backward
build_save_on_cpu: build a context manager that offloads tensors saved for backward to CPU to reduce GPU memory usage
register_multi_grad_hook: register a backward hook that fires after gradients for multiple tensors have been computed
allow_mutation_on_saved_tensors: allow in-place mutation of tensors saved for backward by cloning them before modification
get_gradient_edge: get the gradient edge for a tensor to use as input to autograd.grad
